response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(co.state), ''), '') AS state, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN college co ON co.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(co.state), ''), '')), t AS (SELECT state, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_all, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS tot FROM c) SELECT state, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(cnt / avg_all) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_avg, AVG(cnt / tot) AS avg_share_of_total FROM t GROUP BY state

assumptions.assumption: college.college_id is unique, so joining to college does not duplicate player_college rows.
NULL, empty, and whitespace-only states are merged into one group, reported as an empty string.
The overall average and total count are computed only over colleges with a matching college record (unmatched rows are dropped before these are computed).
